first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and the official horizontal CRS for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official nidirect OSNI 10m Digital Terrain Model technical-information window confirms a 10m regular grid, elevations in metres above mean sea level at Belfast Lough, 1.0m RMSE accuracy, 9.6km x 6.4km tile coverage and Open Data availability. It is a distinct OSNI DTM technical product page rather than the Belfast 2006 ZIP/PDF/CKAN/harvest fingerprints, but it does not identify Belfast 2006 archive-internal tile filenames or a horizontal CRS and is not treated as proof that the 2006 LiDAR zone uses this tile scheme; no tile identifier, geometry, CRS or parcel binding is fabricated.
